_comment: boundedDiagnostic parity cases. `expected` is what the Python SDK's byte-slicing implementation produces: raw[-4096:] then decode(errors='replace') then strip then redact. TypeScript must produce the same string. A TypeScript implementation that slices UTF-16 code units of an already-decoded string fails case 3 and case 4.
